title: Penguin reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- penguin body -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='62' rx='20' ry='26' fill='#3b4a8c'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='66' rx='13' ry='19' fill='#eef1ff'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='32' r='15' fill='#3b4a8c'/>
  <!-- face patches -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='35' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#eef1ff'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='31' r='2.6' fill='#1b2250'/>
  <circle cx='45' cy='31' r='2.6' fill='#1b2250'/>
  <circle cx='35.8' cy='30.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='45.8' cy='30.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M36 39 L44 39 L40 45 Z' fill='#ffb02e'/>
  <!-- belly edge -->
  <path d='M30 48 Q40 44 50 48' stroke='#aab4e0' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- wings/flippers -->
  <ellipse cx='21' cy='62' rx='6' ry='13' fill='#3b4a8c' transform='rotate(-12 21 62)'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='62' rx='6' ry='13' fill='#3b4a8c' transform='rotate(12 59 62)'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <g transform='rotate(-8 55 62)'>
    <rect x='44' y='52' width='24' height='18' rx='2' fill='#e8452c'/>
    <rect x='44' y='52' width='11' height='18' rx='2' fill='#ff6b4a'/>
    <rect x='57' y='52' width='11' height='18' rx='2' fill='#ff6b4a'/>
    <line x1='55.5' y1='52' x2='55.5' y2='70' stroke='#b32c14' stroke-width='1.6'/>
    <line x1='47' y1='58' x2='52' y2='58' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='47' y1='61' x2='52' y2='61' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='47' y1='64' x2='51' y2='64' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='59' y1='58' x2='64' y2='58' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='59' y1='61' x2='64' y2='61' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='89' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#ffb02e'/>
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='89' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#ffb02e'/>
</svg>
